purpose: Seed registry for known Little Light Kids characters. This is source-of-truth starter data, not final production schema.

characters.name: King Light
characters.description: Represents Jesus as the Light who comforts, strengthens, guides, and teaches children to choose truth.

characters.name: Zeke
characters.description: A brave child who learns to stand in faith, choose the light, and trust King Light when others laugh or pressure him.

characters.name: The Whisper
characters.description: A kid-safe picture of lies, fear, pressure, and discouragement that loses power when children choose truth and the light of Jesus.

characters.name: Jude
characters.description: Reminds kids that brave is not the absence of fear.

characters.name: Kai
characters.description: Learns that real influence means leading others toward what is good and true.

characters.name: Nia
characters.description: Shows that kindness can be strong.

characters.name: Toby
characters.description: A child who may act out from hurt but can be reached through grace, kindness, and forgiveness.

characters.name: Grace
characters.description: Gentle and prayerful. Her trust in God steadies the kids around her.
